description: Update source code of an existing ABAP function module. Locks, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates.

activate.description: Activate function module after source update. Default: false. Set to true to activate immediately.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

function_group_name.description: Function group name containing the function module.

function_module_name.description: Function module name. Function module must already exist.

source_code.description: Complete ABAP function module source code, from FUNCTION to ENDFUNCTION.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Required for transportable function modules.

name: UpdateFunctionModule
